draft.hypothesis: The repeated failure pattern shows TARGET_TEST_FAILED with zero edits made before tests, suggesting the agent is not consulting the target tests when constructing patches. Switching from 'off' to 'require' forces the agent to inspect the relevant tests before any edit, which should align its code changes with the expected test behaviors.
draft.expected_effect: The agent will produce patches that are better grounded in the actual test expectations, reducing TARGET_TEST_FAILED occurrences and lowering the average patch attempts required.
draft.possible_risk: If target tests are missing, broken, or require external setup, forcing inspection before editing could stall progress or cause the agent to fail earlier without generating any patch, potentially reducing overall success rate in those edge cases.
